front: Je cherche un appartement à louer, meublé de préférence.
pronunciation: [zhuh shersh an nah-par-tuh-MAHN ah loo-AY, muh-blay duh pray-fay-RAHNS]
back: I'm looking for an apartment to rent, preferably furnished.
context: 'Un meublé' = a furnished rental; leases for furnished flats are usually one year.

front: Le propriétaire exige un garant.
pronunciation: [luh proh-pree-ay-TEHR eg-zeezh an gah-RAHN]
back: The landlord requires a guarantor.
context: A 'garant' signs to pay if you don't. Newcomers without one can apply for the free Visale guarantee.

front: Il faut fournir vos trois dernières fiches de paie.
pronunciation: [eel foh foor-neer voh trwah dehr-nyehr feesh duh PAY]
back: You have to provide your last three payslips.
context: 'Une fiche de paie' / 'un bulletin de salaire' = a payslip.

front: Les charges sont-elles comprises dans le loyer ?
pronunciation: [lay SHARZH sohn-tel kohm-preez dahn luh lwah-YAY]
back: Are the service charges included in the rent?
context: 'Charges comprises (CC)' vs 'hors charges (HC)' in listings.

front: Le dépôt de garantie correspond à un mois de loyer hors charges.
pronunciation: [luh day-poh duh gah-rahn-TEE koh-res-pohn ah an mwah duh lwah-YAY or SHARZH]
back: The security deposit is one month's rent excluding charges.
context: For an unfurnished flat, the deposit is legally capped at one month; two for furnished.

front: Nous ferons l'état des lieux d'entrée samedi.
pronunciation: [noo fuh-rohn lay-tah day LYUH dahn-TRAY sahm-DEE]
back: We'll do the move-in inspection on Saturday.
context: 'L'état des lieux' = the inventory and condition report, done on arrival and departure. Note every scratch!

front: Le bail est de trois ans pour une location vide.
pronunciation: [luh BAHY eh duh trwah ZAHN poor ün loh-kah-syohn VEED]
back: The lease is three years for an unfurnished rental.
context: 'Un bail' (plural 'des baux') = a lease.

front: Je dois donner mon préavis un mois à l'avance.
pronunciation: [zhuh dwah doh-nay mohn pray-ah-VEE an mwah ah lah-VAHNS]
back: I have to give one month's notice.
context: 'Le préavis' = notice period. One month in tense housing areas, otherwise three for unfurnished flats.

front: N'oubliez pas de souscrire une assurance habitation.
pronunciation: [noo-blee-ay pah duh soos-kreer ün nah-sü-rahns ah-bee-tah-SYOHN]
back: Don't forget to take out home insurance.
context: Home insurance is compulsory for tenants in France.

front: Il me faut un justificatif de domicile de moins de trois mois.
pronunciation: [eel muh foh an zhüs-tee-fee-kah-teef duh doh-mee-SEEL duh mwan duh trwah MWAH]
back: I need proof of address less than three months old.
context: Usually an electricity, gas or internet bill. Asked for almost everywhere.

front: J'ai pris rendez-vous en ligne à la préfecture.
pronunciation: [zhay pree rahn-day-VOO ahn LEE-nyuh ah lah pray-fek-TÜR]
back: I booked an appointment online at the prefecture.
context: The 'préfecture' handles residence permits; appointment slots are notoriously hard to get.

front: Je viens déposer une demande de titre de séjour.
pronunciation: [zhuh vyan day-poh-zay ün duh-mahnd duh TEE-truh duh say-ZHOOR]
back: I've come to submit a residence permit application.
context: 'Un titre de séjour' = residence permit; 'déposer un dossier' = to submit an application.

front: Mon récépissé expire à la fin du mois.
pronunciation: [mohn ray-say-pee-SAY ek-speer ah lah fan dü MWAH]
back: My temporary receipt expires at the end of the month.
context: 'Un récépissé' = an official receipt proving your application is in progress.

front: Le dossier est incomplet : il manque l'acte de naissance traduit.
pronunciation: [luh doh-SYAY eh tan-kohm-PLEH : eel mahnk lak-tuh duh neh-sahns trah-DWEE]
back: The file is incomplete: the translated birth certificate is missing.
context: Foreign documents often need a sworn translation ('traduction assermentée').

front: Pouvez-vous me délivrer une attestation ?
pronunciation: [poo-vay-VOO muh day-lee-vray ün nah-tes-tah-SYOHN]
back: Could you issue me a certificate?
context: 'Délivrer' = to issue (a document). 'Une attestation' = official written proof.

front: Je voudrais faire une demande d'aide au logement auprès de la CAF.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo-dreh fehr ün duh-mahnd ded oh lozh-MAHN oh-preh duh lah KAF]
back: I'd like to apply for housing benefit from the CAF.
context: The CAF (Caisse d'allocations familiales) pays housing and family benefits; students often get the APL.

front: Je suis affilié à la Sécurité sociale depuis mars.
pronunciation: [zhuh swee zah-fee-LYAY ah lah say-kü-ree-tay soh-SYAL duh-pwee MARS]
back: I've been registered with Social Security since March.
context: 'La Sécu' covers part of health costs. Your 'numéro de sécu' starts with 1 (men) or 2 (women).

front: J'attends toujours ma carte Vitale.
pronunciation: [zhah-tahn too-zhoor mah kart vee-TAL]
back: I'm still waiting for my carte Vitale.
context: The green health insurance card you show at the doctor's and pharmacy.

front: Avez-vous une mutuelle ?
pronunciation: [ah-vay-VOO ün mü-TWEL]
back: Do you have top-up health insurance?
context: 'Une mutuelle' covers what the Sécu doesn't. Employers must offer one.

front: J'ai déclaré mon médecin traitant.
pronunciation: [zhay day-klah-ray mohn mayd-san treh-TAHN]
back: I've registered my GP.
context: Declaring a 'médecin traitant' gets you better reimbursement rates.

front: Je dois remplir ma déclaration de revenus avant fin mai.
pronunciation: [zhuh dwah rahm-pleer mah day-klah-rah-syohn duh ruh-vuh-NÜ ah-vahn fan MEH]
back: I have to fill in my tax return before the end of May.
context: Since 2019, income tax is withheld at source ('prélèvement à la source'), but you still file a return.

front: Le prélèvement sera effectué le cinq de chaque mois.
pronunciation: [luh pray-lev-MAHN suh-rah eh-fek-TWAY luh sank duh shak MWAH]
back: The direct debit will be taken on the fifth of each month.
context: 'Un prélèvement automatique' = direct debit.

front: Pour ouvrir un compte, il faut un RIB et une pièce d'identité.
pronunciation: [poor oo-vreer an KOHNT, eel foh an REEB ay ün pyes dee-dahn-tee-TAY]
back: To open an account you need bank details and ID.
context: A 'RIB' (relevé d'identité bancaire) is the slip with your IBAN. Employers and landlords ask for it.

front: Je vous écris au sujet de la facture du 12 mars.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo zay-kree oh sü-zheh duh lah fak-tür dü dooz MARS]
back: I'm writing to you regarding the invoice of March 12.
context: 'Au sujet de' = regarding. A standard opening for a formal letter.

front: Je vous adresse ce courrier afin de signaler un dégât des eaux.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo zah-dres suh koo-RYAY ah-fan duh see-nyah-lay an day-gah day ZOH]
back: I am writing to report water damage.
context: 'Adresser un courrier' = to send a letter (formal). 'Un dégât des eaux' = water damage, an insurance classic. Formal letters to strangers open with 'Madame, Monsieur,'.

front: Je vous prie d'agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de mes salutations distinguées.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo pree dah-gray-AY, mah-DAM, muh-SYUH, lek-spreh-SYOHN duh may sah-lü-tah-syohn dees-tan-GAY]
back: Yours faithfully.
context: The traditional French formal closing. 'Veuillez agréer…' is equally correct.

front: Je vous serais reconnaissant de bien vouloir me répondre rapidement.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo suh-reh ruh-koh-neh-SAHN duh byan voo-lwahr muh ray-pohn-druh rah-peed-MAHN]
back: I would be grateful if you could reply promptly.
context: 'Bien vouloir' + infinitive = kindly. Very formal and polite.

front: Veuillez trouver ci-joint les documents demandés.
pronunciation: [vuh-yay troo-vay see-ZHWAN lay doh-kü-mahn duh-mahn-DAY]
back: Please find attached the requested documents.
context: 'Ci-joint' = attached / enclosed.

front: J'ai envoyé le courrier en recommandé avec accusé de réception.
pronunciation: [zhay ahn-vwah-yay luh koo-RYAY ahn ruh-koh-mahn-DAY ah-vek ah-kü-zay duh ray-sep-SYOHN]
back: I sent the letter by registered mail with acknowledgment of receipt.
context: The legal way to terminate a lease, contract or subscription in France.

front: Je souhaite résilier mon abonnement.
pronunciation: [zhuh sweht ray-zee-lyay mohn nah-bun-MAHN]
back: I wish to cancel my subscription.
context: 'Résilier' = to terminate a contract (formal).

front: Je conteste cette amende.
pronunciation: [zhuh kohn-test set ah-MAHND]
back: I'm contesting this fine.
context: Traffic fines are contested on the ANTAI website within 45 days.

front: Tout se fait en ligne sur le site de l'administration.
pronunciation: [too suh feh ahn LEE-nyuh sür luh seet duh lad-mee-nees-trah-SYOHN]
back: Everything is done online on the government website.
context: Most procedures go through service-public.fr or FranceConnect.

front: Il faut se connecter via FranceConnect.
pronunciation: [eel foh suh koh-nek-tay vee-AH frahns-koh-NEKT]
back: You have to log in via FranceConnect.
context: The national login system used for taxes, the Sécu and the CAF.

front: La paperasse administrative me rend fou.
pronunciation: [lah pah-PRAS ad-mee-nees-trah-TEEV muh rahn FOO]
back: The administrative red tape is driving me crazy.
context: 'La paperasse' (informal) = paperwork, red tape.

front: On m'a renvoyé d'un guichet à l'autre toute la matinée.
pronunciation: [ohn mah rahn-vwah-yay dan gee-SHEH ah LOH-truh toot lah mah-tee-NAY]
back: They sent me from one counter to another all morning.
context: 'Un guichet' = a service counter or window.

front: Il faut faire valider votre diplôme étranger.
pronunciation: [eel foh fehr vah-lee-day voh-truh dee-plohm ay-trahn-ZHAY]
back: Your foreign degree has to be recognized.
context: The ENIC-NARIC center issues comparability certificates for foreign diplomas.

front: Je dois échanger mon permis de conduire.
pronunciation: [zhuh dwah ay-shahn-zhay mohn pehr-mee duh kohn-DWEER]
back: I have to exchange my driving license.
context: Non-EU licenses must usually be exchanged within a year of settling in France.

front: Je me suis inscrit à Pôle emploi, qui s'appelle maintenant France Travail.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh swee zan-SKREE ah pohl ahm-PLWAH, kee sah-pel mant-nahn frahns trah-VAHY]
back: I registered with Pôle emploi, which is now called France Travail.
context: The public employment agency was renamed France Travail in 2024.

front: Mon contrat de travail comporte une période d'essai de deux mois.
pronunciation: [mohn kohn-trah duh trah-VAHY kohm-port ün pay-ryud deh-SEH duh duh MWAH]
back: My employment contract includes a two-month trial period.
context: 'La période d'essai' = probation period.

front: C'est un CDI, enfin !
pronunciation: [seh tan say-day-EE, ahn-FAN]
back: It's a permanent contract, at last!
context: CDI = contrat à durée indéterminée (permanent); CDD = fixed-term. A CDI makes renting much easier.

front: J'ai rempli le formulaire Cerfa en trois exemplaires.
pronunciation: [zhay rahn-plee luh for-mü-lehr sehr-FAH ahn trwah zeg-zahn-PLEHR]
back: I filled in the Cerfa form in triplicate.
context: 'Un Cerfa' = an official numbered government form.

front: Faites certifier la copie conforme à la mairie.
pronunciation: [fet sehr-tee-fyay lah koh-pee kohn-FORM ah lah meh-REE]
back: Have the true copy certified at the town hall.
context: Copies certifiées conformes are rarely needed now, but some foreign authorities still ask for them.

front: J'ai fait une procuration pour que ma sœur puisse voter à ma place.
pronunciation: [zhay feh tün proh-kü-rah-SYOHN poor kuh mah suhr pwees voh-tay ah mah PLAS]
back: I gave my sister a proxy so she could vote on my behalf.
context: 'Une procuration' = power of attorney / proxy.

front: Le délai de traitement est de deux à trois mois.
pronunciation: [luh day-LEH duh tret-MAHN eh duh duh zah trwah MWAH]
back: The processing time is two to three months.
context: 'Le délai' = time limit, waiting period.

front: Votre demande est en cours d'instruction.
pronunciation: [voh-truh duh-mahnd eh tahn koor dan-strük-SYOHN]
back: Your application is being processed.
context: Administrative jargon: 'instruire un dossier' = to examine an application.

front: Je souhaiterais faire une réclamation.
pronunciation: [zhuh sweh-tuh-reh fehr ün ray-klah-mah-SYOHN]
back: I would like to make a complaint.
context: 'Une réclamation' = a formal complaint.

front: Le syndic n'a toujours pas réparé l'ascenseur.
pronunciation: [luh san-DEEK nah too-zhoor pah ray-pah-ray lah-sahn-SUHR]
back: The building management still hasn't repaired the lift.
context: 'Le syndic' = the managing agent of a co-owned building.

front: Je cotise pour ma retraite depuis vingt ans.
pronunciation: [zhuh koh-teez poor mah ruh-TRET duh-pwee van TAHN]
back: I've been paying into my pension for twenty years.
context: 'Cotiser' = to pay contributions. 'Les cotisations sociales' come off every payslip.

front: Ma demande de naturalisation a été acceptée.
pronunciation: [mah duh-mahnd duh nah-tü-rah-lee-zah-SYOHN ah ay-tay ak-sep-TAY]
back: My naturalization application was accepted.
context: Candidates need a B2 French certificate (from 2026) and an interview on French values.

front: Je suis enfin en règle.
pronunciation: [zhuh swee zahn-FAN ahn REH-gluh]
back: My papers are finally in order.
context: 'Être en règle' = to have everything legally in order.
